meta.name: vp-cpo-readiness-advisor
meta.description: Guide the transition to VP or CPO across preparing, interviewing, landing, and recalibrating. Use when executive product scope is changing fast.

copy.tagline: 指导从准备到入职的VP/CPO转型全过程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在从产品总监向VP或CPO跃迁
copy.tagline_en: Guide your transition to VP or CPO from preparation to landing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are moving from product director to VP or CPO

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你完成从产品总监到副总裁或 CPO 的过渡，涵盖准备、面试、入职和调整四个阶段。它会先诊断你处于哪个阶段，然后提出针对性问题，最后给出 3-5 条具体建议。
howto.when: 当你提到正在准备晋升 VP/CPO、评估相关职位、刚上任或需要调整时触发。也适用于产品高管职责快速变化的情况。

say.text: 我正准备从总监晋升 VP，帮我规划一下。
say.note: Claude 会询问你的发展重点并给出建议。

say.text: 我拿到了一个 CPO 的 offer，该怎么评估？
say.note: Claude 会引导你分析 CEO 面试问题等关键因素。

say.text: 我当 VP 一年半了，和同级高管合作不顺畅。
say.note: Claude 会帮你重新校准，聚焦联盟建设。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through the transition from Director to VP or CPO across preparing, interviewing, landing, and recalibrating. It diagnoses your stage, asks adaptive questions, and delivers 3-5 targeted recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention preparing for VP/CPO promotion, evaluating a role, recently landed, or recalibrating. Also when executive product scope is changing fast.

say_en.text: I'm a Director preparing for VP roles. Help me plan.
say_en.note: Claude will ask about your development areas and give advice.

say_en.text: I have a CPO offer. How should I evaluate it?
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through CEO interview questions and red flags.

say_en.text: I've been VP for 18 months and peer relationships aren't working.
say_en.note: Claude will help recalibrate, focusing on alliance building.
